verdict.rationale: Render's documented AI capabilities let external agents manage Render: an MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, official skills for those coding agents, and agent-applied plan changes through those integrations. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI assistant inside the Render product itself. These are integrations with third-party agents, which is an adjacent capability, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
